assertion.statement: For K0=Q(sqrt2), Z[sqrt2] has class number1; units modulo squares have four classes distinguished by real signs, and totally positive units are squares.
assertion.objects: K0, its integer ring Z[s], s^2=2, unit epsilon=1+s.
assertion.hypotheses: Integral basis1,s and discriminant8; two real embeddings.
assertion.quantifiers: Every ideal class and every unit of this fixed field.
assertion.parameter_range: Only K0; no varying quadratic-field claim.
assertion.uniformity: Only the stated fixed objects and parameter range are covered; no additional uniform bound is asserted.
assertion.constants: Minkowski bound sqrt2<2; four unit squareclasses.
assertion.normalizations: Use norm of integral ideals and sign pair of the two real embeddings.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This does not identify a fundamental unit; roots of unity are +/-1 because K0 is real.
assertion.limit_order: Apply norm bound to obtain PID; rank and roots of unity give four squareclasses; independent signs of -1,epsilon identify them.
